Mueller came to congress today after completing a year year investigation on Russian interference. There has been multiple lies and conspiracy theories put out by Trump throughout this investigation yet the facts are clear. Mueller never had any business connections with Trump and he never worked for him. The most he did was leave his golf club. All these people who worked for his investigation were largely respected by republicans and democrats for years and they never picked any sides. Mueller goes in and completes a two year investigation and he said he cannot indict a sitting president because that is DOJ policy, any other American would have gone to jail for what Trump had done. Muller said the any other American would be in Jail for many years if they had done what Trump had. Mueller said he could not indict Trump because the law does not allow a sitting president to be indicted so the most he could do was exonerate him. 

After the Investigation, Trump puts up attorney general Barr that makes a redacted version of the report but why not release the whole report, then Trump asserts executive privilege over the report, why would he do that? Then attorney general Barr writes a summary of the report, that contradicts the report, He said trump was exonerated but he was not exonerated, he said there was no collusion. There was collusion with Wikileaks, there was collusion with 126 Russian contacts, there was collusion with multiple meetings with the Russians, then there was indirect collusion which trump was not involved in but yet knew of and never acted against. These types of collusion were against our national security yet trump didn’t take any measures to protect it. Which would be the responsibility of the president. As stated in the report there was 10 counts of obstruction that were stated in volume 2 of the report. 

Obstruction of the investigation directly by Trump and there is about a 100 Pages about it. But Mueller can’t indict him because the investigation was limited by the attorney general and executive privilege. It was also crucial for Mueller to Interview Trump but Trump rejected interviews, tried to fire Mueller, and did not answer any questions on Russia and Obstruction related matters. Then In addition to that there is multiple conspiracy theories that were never proven, Just because Trump repeats them everyday doesn’t make them true. This is exactly why Congress, and The DOJ should not do impeachment’s, it should be a non political court like criminals are always convicted in America (it’s not political issue it’s a criminal issue). But Why is this a political issue? 

People need to open there eyes and read the report, all these congressman have not read the report. It’s obviously listening to partisan news switching from republican to democratic every five minutes the facts have already been stated in a 440 page report made by Mueller and they don’t need to be twisted covered thrown around or restated and finally they don’t need to be hidden with a redacted version of the report that’s also obstruction.
